IDT12420.text:

Wednesday 11 November

Seas: Around 1 metre, increasing to 1 to 1.5 metres during the afternoon or evening.
Weather: Cloudy.

Thursday 12 November
Winds: West to northwesterly about 10 knots tending south to southeasterly 15 to 20 knots during the day then turning southwesterly below 10 knots during the evening.
Seas: Around 1 metre.
Weather: Partly cloudy.
